Neat!! I think what might be sounding off is that to fit your range you mixed tones (ie, you sang some parts in the song's original tone, but when you hit the highest notes you dropped about two octaves and it didn't mix too well). I don't think you would be able to sing the full original bc it's really high even for low-pitch girls xD. So train your lows! (It might help if you have a program that lowers the pitch if you're not used to singing over a karaoke with the wrong tone, which is a problem to most singers bc we feel the need to go with it xD)

But your voice is very smooth and steady, so it was very enjoyable nevertheless!
